title: Mechanism investigation of Duhuo Jisheng pill against rheumatoid arthritis based on a strategy for the integration of network pharmacology, molecular docking and in vivo experimental verification.
authors: Xin, Ping; Xu, Xiaoyun; Zhang, Huaxi; Hu, Yuezhou; Deng, Chengjie; Sun, Shiqin; Liu, Shuang; Zhou, Xuegang; Ma, Hongxing; Li, Xiaoliang
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究中药复方治疗类风湿关节炎的机制，分子对接仅用于药物-靶点结合，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: CONTEXT: Duhuo Jisheng pill (DHJS) is a classic traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formula for rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The effective components and therapeutic mechanisms of DHJS for treating RA are still unclear. OBJECTIVE: To explore the potential mechanism of DHJS against RA by means of network pharmacology and experimental verification. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A network pharmacology and molecular docking analysis based on phytochemistry was used to elucidate the mechanism of DHJS against RA. The targets of DHJS anti-RA active ingredient were obtained by searching TCMSP, ETCM and TCMSID. The RA model induced by collagen was established in Wistar rats. The rats in the DHJS group were administered doses of 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 g/kg for a period of 10 d. The expression of targets was measured with Western blot. RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis showed that the anti-RA effect of DHJS was mediated by targets involved in immunity, inflammation and apoptosis, as well as PI3K-Akt and NF-kappaB signalling pathways. Of 2.0 g/kg DHJS significantly alleviated the ankle inflammation (IL-6: 62.73 +/- 8.39 pg/mL, IL-1beta: 50.49 +/- 11.47 pg/mL, TNF-alpha: 16.88 +/- 3.05 pg/mL, IL-17A: 12.55 +/- 1.87 pg/mL, IL-10: 16.24 +/- 3.00 pg/mL), comparing with the model group (IL-6: 92.02 +/- 13.25 pg/mL, IL-1beta: 71.85 +/- 4.12 pg/mL, TNF-alpha: 25.64 +/- 3.69 pg/mL, IL-17A: 22.14 +/- 4.56 pg/mL, IL-10: 9.51 +/- 3.03 pg/mL) (p < 0.05). Moreover, the protein expression of p-PI3K, p-AKT and p-p65 significantly decreased after DHJS administration. CONCLUSIONS: DHJS could alleviate the collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) by the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signalling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：独活寄生丸（DHJS）是一种用于类风湿关节炎（RA）的经典中药方剂。DHJS治疗RA的有效成分及治疗机制尚不明确。目的：通过网络药理学和实验验证，探讨DHJS抗RA的潜在机制。材料与方法：采用基于植物化学的网络药理学和分子对接分析，阐明DHJS抗RA的机制。通过检索TCMSP、ETCM和TCMSID数据库，获取DHJS抗RA活性成分的靶点。在Wistar大鼠中建立胶原诱导的RA模型。DHJS组大鼠给予0.5、1.0和2.0 g/kg的剂量，持续10天。用Western blot检测靶点表达。结果：网络药理学分析显示，DHJS的抗RA效应由涉及免疫、炎症和凋亡的靶点以及PI3K-Akt和NF-kappaB信号通路介导。其中，2.0 g/kg DHJS显著缓解踝关节炎症（IL-6：62.73 ± 8.39 pg/mL，IL-1β：50.49 ± 11.47 pg/mL，TNF-α：16.88 ± 3.05 pg/mL，IL-17A：12.55 ± 1.87 pg/mL，IL-10：16.24 ± 3.00 pg/mL），与模型组相比（IL-6：92.02 ± 13.25 pg/mL，IL-1β：71.85 ± 4.12 pg/mL，TNF-α：25.64 ± 3.69 pg/mL，IL-17A：22.14 ± 4.56 pg/mL，IL-10：9.51 ± 3.03 pg/mL）（p < 0.05）。此外，DHJS给药后，p-PI3K、p-AKT和p-p65的蛋白表达显著降低。结论：DHJS可通过PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路缓解胶原诱导的关节炎（CIA）。
